purpose: Render development docs from a finalized canonical state fixture.
constraints: Keep generated docs deterministic and easy to audit.

product.problemStatement: Development-mode rendering needs a stable, reusable finalized-state fixture.
product.whyNow: Regression coverage should not depend only on inline test scaffolding.
product.expectedValue: Reliable render and validation tests for the development-mode contract.
product.solutionSummary: Use a checked-in finalized-state fixture to drive render and validation regressions.
product.mvpScope: Exercise render-development-docs and validate-development from canonical state.
product.assumptions: Development docs are generated from canonical state and templates.

governance.keyDecisions: Treat finalized canonical state as the render source of truth.
governance.topRisks: Rendered docs drift from the state schema or validation contract.
governance.mitigationPlans: Keep a stable fixture and assert render-plus-validate in CI.
governance.contingencies: Refresh the fixture when the state schema evolves intentionally.
governance.remainingAcceptedRisks: Fixtures may need periodic wording updates as templates change.
